parsed.note_claim: The Apollo spacecraft used onboard guidance computers and inertial navigation.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Apollo Guidance Computer ( AGC ) is a digital computer produced for the Apollo program that was installed on board each Apollo command module (CM) and Apollo Lunar Module (LM).
parsed.reason: The page confirms the AGC was installed on board Apollo spacecraft and lists IMU ports, directly substantiating the note's claim about onboard computers and navigation.
